title: Figure 27: Monthly Distribution of Insufficient-Information vs. Other Object Sightings
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart comparing the monthly distribution, January through December, of "Total Less Insufficient Information" object sightings (left) with sightings evaluated as "Insufficient Information" (right), both in percent from 0 to 40. July and August have the longest bars. Caption: "FIGURE 27 COMPARISON OF MONTHLY DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS EVALUATED AS INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION VERSUS TOTAL OBJECT SIGHTINGS LESS INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION"; drawing A-7505.
